finding.title: gate file misattributes the commit that introduced --unsetenv-all
finding.detail: tasks/factory/wreg-GATES.md says '--unsetenv-all to the podman run arguments (662682a00, ...)'. git log -S"unsetenv-all" -- packages/@ezcorp/extension-runner/src/podman.ts shows the flag first appears in commit e0598fe79 ('feat(factory): isolated Python guest with a Python-native C02 validator'), not 662682a00. Verified directly: `git show 662682a00 -- packages/@ezcorp/extension-runner/src/podman.ts` only renames/splits the RUNNER_GUEST_ENVIRONMENT constant (no args() change); `git show e0598fe79^:...podman.ts | grep unsetenv-all` is empty and `git show e0598fe79:...podman.ts | grep unsetenv-all` shows two hits (docstring + args array). e0598fe79's own commit message independently confirms the same causal claim about PATH loss, so the root-cause NARRATIVE is correct and the W02 attribution is still correct (e0598fe79 is also part of the W02 Python-isolation merge range) — only the cited SHA is wrong. Does not affect the fix's correctness or the verdict; should be corrected in the gate file for anyone bisecting from that citation.
